# MIT OpenCourseWare

> > MIT OpenCourseWare provides free, open access to MIT course materials spanning science, engineering, humanities, and professional development.

MIT OpenCourseWare (OCW) is a pioneering open educational resource platform that publishes MIT's course content online for free worldwide access. The platform includes lecture notes, course materials, and curated collections organized by subject area and topic, supporting both self-directed learners and educators.

## Getting Started

- [MIT OpenCourseWare | Free Online Course Materials](https://ocw.mit.edu): MIT OpenCourseWare homepage: free online MIT course content
- [Get Started | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/pages/get-started): Getting started guide for using OCW platform and resources
- [About Us | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/about): About page describing OCW mission and OER movement history

## Featured Course Collections

- [Energy | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/collections/energy): Curated collection of energy-related courses and studies
- [Entrepreneurship | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/collections/entrepreneurship): Curated collection of entrepreneurship and business courses
- [Africana Studies | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/collections/africana-studies): Curated collection of Africana and African American studies courses

## Computer Science & Programming

- [Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python | Electrical Engineering and Computer Science](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/6-0001-introduction-to-computer-science-and-programming-in-python-fall-2016): Beginner Python programming and computer science fundamentals
- [Day of AI | Media Arts and Sciences](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-mas-002-day-of-ai-spring-2022): AI curriculum and teacher training for K-12 education

## Science & Engineering Courses

- [General Biochemistry | Biology](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/7-05-general-biochemistry-spring-2020): Biochemistry course covering macromolecules and metabolism
- [Introductory Biology | Biology](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/7-016-introductory-biology-fall-2018): Introductory biology covering biochemistry and molecular biology
- [Quantum Theory of Radiation Interactions | Nuclear Science and Engineering](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/22-51-quantum-theory-of-radiation-interactions-fall-2012): Graduate course on quantum mechanics and radiation interactions
- [Ecology I: The Earth System | Civil and Environmental Engineering](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/1-018j-ecology-i-the-earth-system-fall-2009): Ecology fundamentals covering Earth systems and ecosystems
- [How to CAD Almost Anything | Aeronautics and Astronautics](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-16-002-how-to-cad-almost-anything-january-iap-2024): CAD tutorial course covering Solidworks, Fusion 360, 3D modeling

## Professional Development & Specialized Topics

- [Making Science and Engineering Pictures: A Practical Guide to Presenting Your Work | Chemical Engineering](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-10-001-making-science-and-engineering-pictures-a-practical-guide-to-presenting-your-work-spring-2026): Photography and visual communication guide for science imaging
- [Financing Economic Development | Urban Studies and Planning](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/11-437-financing-economic-development-fall-2016): Graduate course on economic development finance tools

## Arts & Humanities

- [Landscape Experience: Seminar in Land/Art | Architecture](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/4-s67-landscape-experience-seminar-in-land-art-fall-2016): Graduate seminar on land art and landscape architecture
- [Chinese Popular Musics in Dialogue | Music and Theater Arts](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/21m-s53-chinese-popular-musics-in-dialogue-spring-2014): Course on Chinese popular music genres and cultural identity

## Support & Resources

- [Educator | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/educator): Resources and guides for educators using OCW materials
- [Contact | MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/contact): Contact and FAQ page for OCW support and information

## Optional

- [Chemistry of Sports | Experimental Study Group](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/es-010-chemistry-of-sports-spring-2013): Seminar on chemistry and physiology of sports and exercise
